title: solver_card
description: EchoForge solver_card document. Describes an electromagnetic solver implementation (family, version, container image, supported polarizations) that may be invoked by campaigns. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'solver_card' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy solver (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the solver_card content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

solver_name.description: Human-readable solver name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

solver_family.description: Coarse solver taxonomy bucket. Examples: sbr | po | go | mom | fdtd | fem | hybrid | analytic. Free-form non-empty string (no strict enum at the schema layer).

version.description: Solver version string (e.g. semantic version or build tag). Non-empty string.

container_image.description: OCI container image reference for reproducible execution. Prefer a digest-pinned form such as name@sha256:<hex>.

supported_polarizations.description: Polarization modes the solver can emit/accept. Each entry must be one of 'H' (horizontal), 'V' (vertical), 'L' (left circular), or 'R' (right circular). At least one entry required.
